patterns.note: The homepage features a full-bleed, overlapping collage of large text and project images, creating a dynamic, non-grid-based visual experience.
Oversized, italicized sans-serif text is used as a primary visual element on the homepage, dynamically interacting with project thumbnails.
A high-contrast palette of pure black background, crisp white text, and a vibrant hot pink accent color is used consistently for interactive elements and borders.
Large, italicized project titles and associated project images scroll at different speeds, creating a layered parallax effect that reveals new content as the user scrolls down the homepage.
A full-width newsletter signup form, framed by the accent color, is consistently placed at the bottom of both the homepage and interior project pages.

technique_notes: The primary visual effect on the homepage is a layered parallax scroll, where large, italicized text elements and background images move at slightly different speeds as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic, overlapping collage that reveals new content. The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access.
Interactive elements like navigation filters and buttons use a high-contrast accent color for their borders and text, providing clear visual feedback against the dark background.
Interior pages adopt a more structured, two-column layout for project details, contrasting with the dynamic homepage while maintaining the overall color and typography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, italicized display text (~5-6x body) is used as a primary visual element, contrasted with smaller, uppercase navigation and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for all interactive elements, content blocks, and image frames.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and dynamic in the hero section with large overlapping elements; more balanced and structured on interior detail pages with clear content separation.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic, full-bleed, overlapping text and image collage on the homepage, where large, italicized project titles parallax over and under project thumbnails as the user scrolls. This creates a highly engaging and artistic visual experience that feels more like an interactive art piece than a traditional website, effectively conveying a bold and editorial brand identity.
